answer: In a lagoon marketplace, agents trading saffron or sable should earn reputation only from randomly assigned audits, not mutual endorsements. Choose auditors after sellers commit their work, using an unpredictable public seed, and cap how much one counterparty can boost another. A fake-account farm must control many independently selected auditors to certify its own junk; buying that coverage raises its cost. This reduces collusive reputation farming but still needs an honest initial auditor pool.
